column2: For b > 0: a = bq + r with \(0 \leq r < b\), and q, r unique.
If a = bq + r, then gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, r).
Replace (a, b) by (b, a mod b) until the second number is 0. The first number is the gcd.
There are integers x, y with ax + by = gcd(a, b).
If p is prime and \(p \mid ab\), then \(p \mid a\) or \(p \mid b\).
